name: Engage on posts
description: Scroll content human-like; like when relevance is solid; comment only when score is high. Dry-run: react yes, type comment without sending.

env.name: VISIBILITY_DRY_RUN
env.description: React yes; type comment but do not click Post/Send

env.name: VISIBILITY_KEYWORDS
env.description: Topics used for content search + relevance scoring

env.name: VISIBILITY_LIKE_MIN_SCORE
env.description: Minimum relevance (0-100) to like a post

env.name: VISIBILITY_COMMENT_MIN_SCORE
env.description: Minimum relevance (0-100) to type/send a comment

env.name: VISIBILITY_MAX_COMMENTS
env.description: Max comments typed (sent only when not dry-run)

env.name: VISIBILITY_MAX_SCAN
env.description: Max post cards to evaluate while scrolling
